authorization: 用户于2026-10-26 10:42明确选择: 等现有末轮队列跑完后启动 best 版全量重跑, 且只报 best 口径(复现原版语义)。本配置记录该授权范围。

relationship_to_final_epoch_queue.why_fold0_is_retrained: fold0 的末轮产物是在末轮口径下产出的, 不能与 best 口径的折混入同一个五折统计。best 队列对五折全部重训, 而不是把末轮的 fold0 拼进来。

stages.hyperparameters: Locked core lr .0005, probe lr .0005, Gram weight10, paper weight1 temperature.5, content weight5; no heldout tuning.
stages.purpose: Complete the eleven-arm BLCA five-fold picture at seed3 under the original per-epoch best-validation checkpoint rule, which is the only difference from the completed final-epoch queue.

requested_scope.fold_seed_choice: seed3 only, as instructed; no additional seeds are introduced.

matched_protocol: Same eligible patients per fold, same split hashes, same real-patch cache/order, and train-fold-only survival bins fitted independently per fold
Same seed-specific initial core/probe weights and data batches within each fold; all eleven arms of a fold share one initialization and one sampling schedule
Same survival/auxiliary/reconstruction objectives plus the explicitly itemized experimental losses
Same repeated-evaluation seeds and the same 20-repeat evaluation contract; only the checkpoint rule differs
Every private feature, identifier, weight, raw prediction and per-case array stays under ignored local_evidence

checkpoint_rule.per_epoch: one full validation-fold pass after each of the 30 epochs, using the original risk definition -sum(cumprod(1-sigmoid(logits))) and the same fixed patch subset and evaluation seed schedule as the final evaluation
checkpoint_rule.tie_rule: a later epoch whose value is greater than or equal to the running maximum replaces the retained epoch, matching the original comparison
checkpoint_rule.final: after the final epoch the retained best weights are loaded and evaluated once more with the full 20-repeat contract
checkpoint_rule.rng_isolation: the per-epoch validation pass restores the python, numpy and torch CPU/CUDA global random streams, so the training trajectory of this queue equals the training trajectory of the completed final-epoch queue for the same arm, fold and seed
checkpoint_rule.verified: tests/test_slotspe_redundancy_best_engine.py::test_best_run_training_trajectory_matches_the_final_epoch_run compares the retained per-batch training rows of both protocols and requires them to be identical

required_metrics: Per-fold C-index of the retained best checkpoint, averaged over the 20 evaluation repeats
Five-fold mean and between-fold standard deviation over the five per-fold values
The retained best epoch per fold
The per-epoch validation C-index trajectory of every arm
The 20 repeats are aggregated inside a fold first and are never the units of the five-fold statistic
decision_boundary: This queue completes a five-fold single-seed comparison of one SlotSPE implementation family under the original best-checkpoint rule. The reported C-index is a validation-selected peak, which is not an independently tested generalization result. Low cosine alone does not authorize a claim, and no multiplicity-corrected significance is asserted here.

pin_refresh_note.change: New configuration for the best-checkpoint queue. It pins the same byte-for-byte original SlotSPE source as the final-epoch queue and adds the two new implementation modules.
pin_refresh_note.final_epoch_queue_unchanged: The final-epoch queue's own configuration, pins and artifacts are untouched by this file.
